title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Agreement Settlement and Closing
content:
A Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement carries two amounts: the **balance**, which is what the renter owes (rental time, damage protection, fees and refunds paid out raise it; payments, an applied deposit and credits lower it), and the **deposit held**, which is the security or reservation deposit currently held (collected in; applied to the balance or released out).

## Settlement rules

1. **At return.** At return the agreement is settled: every charge is billed, a held deposit is applied to the balance up to the balance owed and any remainder is released, and the renter pays what is still owed on one of the class's tenders for rental charges.
2. **Payable statuses.** Payments are accepted on agreements whose status is on rent, overdue, returned or converted, as the agreement record shows.
3. **Overpayment.** When credits leave the agreement overpaid, the overpayment is refunded to the tender of the most recent payment, never above that payment.
4. **Closing.** An agreement closes when its balance is 0.00 and its deposit held is 0.00. A returned agreement closes once settled; a converted agreement closes once the replacement charge is paid.

The amount paid on an agreement is the payments received on it less the refunds issued on it.

## Hypothetical settlements

| Balance at return | Deposit held | Deposit applied | Deposit released | Still owed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 180.00 | 250.00 | 180.00 | 70.00 | 0.00 |
| 420.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 0.00 | 270.00 |

*Overpayment (hypothetical):* a renter paid 120.00 on a bank card and later 60.00 in cash; a credit then leaves the agreement 40.00 overpaid. The most recent payment is the 60.00 cash payment, so the 40.00 is refunded to cash. Had the overpayment been 75.00, the refund to cash would not exceed 60.00, the amount of that payment.

| Agreement status | Payment accepted |
|---|---|
| reserved | no |
| on rent, overdue, returned, converted | yes |
| closed, cancelled | no |
